# Nordic Desk front end Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:executing-plans (or subagent-driven-development). Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax.

**Goal:** Turn the approved mockups into the real views: Aamu (quick morning review, phone first) and Huurre (deep-dive desk on the computer: Desk, Impact, Compare), reading only `out/desk.json` and `out/aamu.json`.

**Architecture:** Static HTML generated by Python, as the mockups were: one render module with tokens, base CSS and SVG chart helpers, one module per view, a `nordic-desk site` command writing `out/site/*.html` (git-ignored, holds real data). Small inline script only for picking a stock, the compare set and the what-if scenario (state in the URL hash). No framework, no server.

**Tech Stack:** Python 3.12, uv, pytest; Hallmark (`sloplint --scope app`), dataviz rules; headless Chrome for screenshots.

**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-18-nordic-desk-design.md`. Visual source of truth: `docs/mockups/huurre.html`, `aamu.html`, `impact.html`; their generators `docs/mockups/src/gen.py` and `impact_page.py` hold the markup, tokens and chart code to port. Data: `docs/data-contract.md`.

## Global Constraints

- Huurre look: Console theme, paper colourway cooled to hoarfrost, Host Grotesk + Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono. Aamu look: Piste snow, Finnish blue `oklch(42% 0.19 262)`, Barlow Condensed + Barlow. Kaamos is dropped.
- Hallmark floor: tokens only, sentence-case labels, no tracked capitals, focus-visible, reduced motion, `overflow-x: clip`, stamp line first in CSS. `sloplint --scope app` clean on every page.
- Times in Helsinki (US close 23:00, open 16:30); money in euros; every page names its sources and says it is not investment advice.
- Real data only under `out/`. Screenshots for the README or anything shared use `config/holdings.example.toml`.

## Review Focus

- A ticker in `meta.skipped` → the views leave it out and say so in one line, never break.
- No `--record` → Impact hides the record section instead of showing empty charts.
- Phone width 390 px → Aamu has no horizontal page scroll; Huurre tables scroll inside their own box.
- A missing company fact → shows "not reported", never a blank or a guess.
- Script disabled → the default stock, compare set and scenario are still visible.

---

### Task 1: Company facts in the engine
Fetch P/E (trailing, forward), market cap, dividend yield, sector, industry and earnings date per watchlist ticker (`yfinance` `.info`), cache in `data/info.json`, add `detail.<ticker>.facts` to the contract. Tests with a fake fetch; missing fields stay `null`.

### Task 2: Render core
`src/nordic_desk/views/core.py`: tokens per look, base CSS, `pct`, `eur`, `usd`, `spark`, `line_chart`, `rangebar`, page shell with stamp. Port from `gen.py`. Tests: number formats (minus sign, no space before %), chart output has one y axis and 3–5 grid lines.

### Task 3: Huurre Desk
Watchlist ledger (price, today, 1 month, YTD, 52-week range, 3-month trace), selected stock panel (chart against SPY, periods, facts, "you hold" line), portfolio strip, states block (loading, empty, error). Test: page renders from a fixture `desk.json`; no NaN; skipped tickers listed.

### Task 4: Huurre Impact
Money against risk bars, what-if (add 500/1000/2500/5000, sell and spread), ranking table, glossary, record when present. Port from `impact_page.py`. Test: every scenario id in the JSON has a block; default visible without script.

### Task 5: Huurre Compare
Up to four stocks rebased to 100 with SPY, metrics table. Test: default three selected; fourth limit enforced in markup (`disabled`).

### Task 6: Aamu
Masthead "Last night in New York", portfolio value large, one-sentence summary against SPY, movers up and down, twelve small multiples on one scale, currency effect. Phone first. Test: sentence picks "ahead"/"behind" correctly from fixture numbers.

### Task 7: `nordic-desk site` and checks
Command writes `out/site/index.html` (links), `desk.html`, `impact.html`, `compare.html`, `aamu.html`, `holdings.html`. Run `sloplint --scope app --render`, screenshots at 390 and 1440, final review. Accept when all pages lint clean and the numbers match `out/*.json`.

## Later
Hosting Aamu where the phone can reach it without exposing holdings; longer history and forecasts (GARCH-t, block bootstrap, regime switching) with calibration.
